title: Edge-AI-Driven Learning-to-Rank for Decentralized Task Allocation in Circular Smart Manufacturing
abstract: arXiv:2605.16433v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Task allocation in smart manufacturing systems must operate under decentralized decision-making, dynamic workloads, and shared-resource constraints. In circular manufacturing settings, these challenges are further intensified because tasks compete for reusable, capacity-constrained assets, and machine selection also might affect processing energy. Although learning-based approaches have been explored for task allocation, improvements in predictive modeling do not necessarily translate into better allocation outcomes under decentralized negotiation. This work proposes an Edge-AI-driven decentralized task-allocation framework. We develop lightweight decision intelligence deployed at the machine level. It is developed progressively: first, a resource-aware heuristic establishes the decentralized bidding structure; a regression-based Edge-AI formulation then examines learned local bid approximation, and a compact autoencoder-regula

translated_title: 边缘AI驱动的去中心化任务分配学习排序在循环智能制造中的应用
translated_abstract: 智能制造系统中的任务分配必须在去中心化决策、动态工作负载和共享资源约束下运行。在循环制造环境中，这些挑战进一步加剧，因为任务竞争可重复使用、容量受限的资产，且机器选择还可能影响加工能耗。尽管已有基于学习的方法被探索用于任务分配，但预测模型的改进并不一定能在去中心化谈判中转化为更好的分配结果。本工作提出了一种边缘AI驱动的去中心化任务分配框架。我们开发了部署在机器级别的轻量级决策智能体。该框架逐步构建：首先，一种资源感知启发式方法建立去中心化投标结构；其次，基于回归的边缘AI公式检验学习到的局部投标近似；最后，一种紧凑的自编码器正则化方法进一步优化。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种边缘AI驱动的去中心化任务分配框架，通过轻量级决策智能体结合资源感知启发式和回归模型，在循环制造中实现高效的任务分配，同时兼顾能耗和资源约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Edge-AI-driven decentralized task allocation framework that combines resource-aware heuristics with regression-based lightweight decision intelligence to achieve efficient allocation in circular smart manufacturing while considering energy and resource constraints.
